resolvedDuringAcceptance: A device preflight correctly showed a closed thread but its disabled reply button was below the accessibility viewport. The harness now performs actual native scrolling before checking the disabled control. The focused six-check current-API device run then passed, followed by the complete final79-check journey; no product code or APK changed for this harness correction.

Initial complete verification reported newly published DOMPurify and sanitize-html advisories. Root dependencies upgraded to official patched3.4.17/2.18.1 with targeted regression inputs and actual four-engine browser checks; root audit returned zero and the default full flow was restarted. The preceding native run was retained only as UI preflight; final native acceptance uses rebuilt patched API. Browser regression launch options were corrected to avoid inheriting the macOS Chrome channel into Firefox/WebKit; all four real engines pass.

Initial ad-hoc dedicated test command lacked explicit fixture review database opt-in and imported a decorated controller into a plain test transform. Schemas were separated into a decorator-free module and the actual API was rebuilt; all15 dedicated checks then passed.

First HTTPS packaging attempt failed at Android packageRelease without an underlying cause in its initial log. The unchanged standard build was rerun with full Gradle stacktrace logging and passed. Final signatures, embedded origins, version/manifest and bundled assets were verified; the first failure log is retained locally.

Review found the initial device harness would tap the private receipt action twice instead of first observing the uncertain state. The already running superseded fixture was intentionally stopped through the owned preview app so normal cleanup ran. Corrected dedicated harness was typechecked and the complete79-check Android journey rerun; product API/native source and final APKs did not change.
